name: Ludo Fighters: Battle Board
summary: Ludo Fighters: Battle Board is a battle take on the classic board game Ludo for Android and iOS. Players roll the dice to deploy and race squads of cartoon soldiers around the board; landing on an enemy starts a short cartoon gun fight instead of a simple capture. Matches support 2 to 6 squads on 4-house or 6-house boards across six battlefields, with optional rules such as landmines, killstreaks, bounty, supply drops, chaos cards and 2 v 2 Squad Wars. Modes include play against Lumi AI, pass and play on one device, and online matches with quick battles and private rooms.
